email.footer: Kotuwa Marketplace. If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

verifyEmail.subject: Verify your email address
verifyEmail.body: Thanks for joining Kotuwa. Please confirm your email address to activate your account.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We received a request to reset your password.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: Your password was just changed and you were logged out on all devices. If this was not you, reset your password immediately.

shopStatusChanged.subject: Update on your shop {{shopName}}
shopStatusChanged.approved: Good news! Your shop has been approved. You can now submit products for sale.
shopStatusChanged.suspended: Your shop has been suspended. Buyers cannot see your products until it is restored.
shopStatusChanged.rejected: Your shop application was not approved. You can update your shop details and they will be reviewed again.

productStatusChanged.subject: Update on your product {{productName}}
productStatusChanged.approved: Your product has been approved and is now visible to buyers.
productStatusChanged.rejected: Your product was not approved. Please fix it and submit it again.

orderPlaced.subject: Order {{orderNumber}} placed
orderPlaced.body: Thank you! We have received your order {{orderNumber}}.
orderPlaced.grandTotal: Total to pay in cash on delivery
orderPlaced.footer: Each shop sends its part separately. You can follow every part on your order page.

newSubOrder.subject: New order {{subOrderNumber}}
newSubOrder.body: You have a new order to prepare.
